content: We need number of CH3 groups in the compound. But we have no description of compound. Possibly need to get NMR spectra to infer? Could be ambiguous. Maybe the compound is known from context? No context given. We may need to request proton NMR to count methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed?). It says takes SMILES string, but no argument. The tool signature: proton_nmr_spectra(_: {}) => any. No parameters. So it will return spectra for "sample at hand". Probably there is a hidden sample. Let's call it.
